So I'm basically wondering why my phone's location is being accessed while my phone is asleep...does anyone have any insight?
Whenever I wake up my phone I see the location indicator quickly disappear?
A variety of reasons could be the case - an app you have running in the background, Android Device Manager updating your location history, Play Services update, etc.

So if you download one of the apps that gets you to the hidden fine grained permissions control menu on... 4.2? 4.3? and after, you might find a shitload of stuff can access location that has no good reason to do so.

And then, you may be asking yourself: Why does my clock need my location? Why does my built in music player need my location?

An odd app that has no reason to use your location might not be the problem, but its a good place as any to start your search for the issue.
I'll take a look a that for sure. I usually close all my background apps when I'm done using my phone, which was my main reason for worrying that my location was being accessed.

If you're rooted, I recommend Greenifying anything that you don't need instant notifications/updates from. I believe it stops rogue apps from accessing your location and it has done wonders for my battery life. I used to only get 8-10 hours and now can last 24 hours, although I end up with 5% or so after waking up.

Chances are some Google app is probably accessing your location though and I wouldn't really recommend Greenifying those.
